_comment: CI-only. Capacitor ties console logging to FLAG_DEBUGGABLE unless
loggingBehavior says otherwise, and the r8Test APK is release-configured,
so without this the SP_SMOKE markers never reach logcat and the smoke can
only time out. Installed by .github/workflows/android-tests.yml; nothing
else writes this file in CI. Nothing here has to match capacitor.config.ts.
